title: "I don't deal combat damage" is not honored in combat resolution
expected: Ezreal (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/ezreal-dashing.ts:49-54) grants itself keyword "NoCombatDamage", but the engine never consults that keyword: grep for "NoCombatDamage" in riftbound-engine/src returns zero hits. CombatUnit.dealsNoCombatDamage is set only for stunned units (game-definition/moves/combat/resolve-full-combat.ts:337-341) and the Vilemaw PreventWeakerEnemyCombatDamage threshold (combat/combat-resolver.ts:152-166); calculateSideMight (combat-resolver.ts:136-145) skips only units with that flag, so Ezreal contributes full Might and kills the Mech.
observed: After resolveFullCombat both Ezreal AND the Mech were removed (Ezreal to trash, Mech token gone; battlefield empty). Ezreal's card meta shows grantedKeywords:[{keyword:'NoCombatDamage',duration:'static'}] but combat-resolver.ts only sets dealsNoCombatDamage for stunned units / Vilemaw threshold; the 'NoCombatDamage' keyword is never consulted in resolve-full-combat.ts, so Ezreal contributed his full Might as combat damage.

history.note: NoCombatDamage keyword (printed or self-granted static) now sets dealsNoCombatDamage in the CombatUnit build

resolution.note: NoCombatDamage keyword (printed or self-granted static) now sets dealsNoCombatDamage in the CombatUnit build
